text:
Nora (AE): MedSigma asked for a 4-week POC. Must-haves: VPC peering + KMS, retention 30d, SOC2 questionnaire started, legal NDA inbound. Acceptance asks: p95 <= 160ms in-region, automated quality >= 94% on 140 labeled prompts, and pilot cost target <= $0.28/1k tokens. Can we sketch the acceptance playbook + burn estimate before kickoff? Kickoff Wed 9am PT.

Diego (Sales-Eng): I can own the eval harness. Need the prompt mix: roughly 60% extraction, 30% summarization, 10% classification. Also need their reference outputs and the labeled CSV.

Hannah (Solutions): For latency target we propose redwood-rt-7b-quant for short-context extraction flows and redwood-rt-13b-quant for summarization. Use kv_cache=true, batch_size=5 for extraction-heavy runs to hit 160ms p95. We'll supply both model configs in the runbook.

Omar (SRE): Token math quick: assume avg 220 tokens/request, target 18 RPS peak -> 220*18 = 3960 tokens/s ~14.3M tokens/hr. For acceptance focused tests over 40 hours of peak-equivalent runs => ~572M tokens. But a conservative pilot burn estimate = 180M tokens. At $0.28/1k that's ~$50.4k gross. Recommend offering $20k trial credit and cap exposure at $30k.

Priya (Product): Acceptance gates I suggest: 1) Automated eval (140 prompts) pass rate >=94% 2) p95 <=160ms under specified concurrency profile 3) No high-severity PII leakage on a 30-case adversarial set 4) SOC2 questionnaire answers delivered and KMS provisioning validated 5) Final manual review: 12 spot checks.

Diego (Sales-Eng): Eval run snippet (captures latency + output):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"model":"${MODEL}","prompt":"<PROMPT>","max_tokens":180,"temperature":0.0}' | jq -r '.meta.latency_ms as $ms | .output | {text: ., latency_ms: $ms}'
```
I'll persist records to a CSV for scoring.

Hannah (Solutions): Also enable prefix_caching for system prompts and response_dedupe during automated runs to reduce repeat burn. We should set no-store=true and retention_days=30. For VPC we need their CIDR and KMS key ARN.

Omar (SRE): I'll start an infra ticket. Provisioning ETA once we have CIDR + KMS = 4 business days. For Dedicated VPC endpoint we'll need a signed AUP from legal.

sec-bot: SOC2 questionnaire created: https://redeploy.internal/soc2/medsigma (owner: security@redwood)

Nora (AE): Timeline draft: Week 0 - collect labeled set + SOC2 answers; Week 1 - baseline runs + canary; Week 2 - tuning & adversarial PII tests; Week 3 - soak & acceptance runs; Week 4 - final sign-off & handoff. Deliverables: Diego = harness by Fri EOD; Omar = infra ticket + ETA; Hannah = canary configs + model variants.

Diego (Sales-Eng): I'll push harness + scoring notebook to their GH repo and share runbook by Thursday.

Priya (Product): Add a synthetic 30-min canary and 2-hour sustained soak to the acceptance runbook. We'll use these to validate p95 and KV cache behavior.

Omar (SRE): Noted. Opening ticket now. Need CIDR, KMS ARN, and legal AUP to proceed.

Nora (AE): Great. Action items recap in-thread. Please update when done. Also cc pricing-ops for trial credit approval. :thumbsup:
